description: This file defines a VideoApiAdapter implementation for managing video meetings via the Shimmer platform, including creating, updating, deleting meetings, and fetching recordings. It also includes API fetchers and schema validation for Daily.co API responses.

classes.name: VideoApiAdapter
classes.description: Interface for video API adapters, implemented by ShimmerDailyVideoApiAdapter.

methods.name: createOrUpdateMeeting
methods.description: Creates or updates a video meeting using the Shimmer API, returning VideoCallData.

methods.name: translateEvent
methods.description: Prepares the event properties for the API call, enabling various UI features.
